name: Traverses Component
description: The path role of the reachability compound edge (req-grid-edge-compound): an Amazon Inspector v2 network-reachability finding -> each route table, security group and network ACL its networkPath.steps passes through. The property step is the component's position in the path (0-based), not identity. A reference that retires nothing: deleting a component ends this edge and leaves the finding. Collected by collectors/boto3_collector/inspector.py (aws-core-tap#261).

step.description: The component's 0-based position in networkPath.steps, as Inspector returned them.
